Step: Data Migration - prerequisites (before the first data source)
Users' on-call Schedule cleared (or set to a work schedule) on users who are Adaptive resources
Notes: Without it, resource assignments are refused (Validate Resource availability). Can be done after go-live day; Resources then run later.

Step: System properties set: x_mig.adaptive.url / key (PROD key), pilot = all, states = Active;On Hold, project_types = Project;Construction;Operational Projects, batch = 1/7, scope = latest
Notes: Property names exactly as listed (states with an s).

Step: x_mig.migration_running = true; notifications suppressed (row 13); 'Restrict time card to unassigned user' inactive (row 12)
Old maps inactive: Adaptive Capex Budget, Adaptive Opex Budget, Adaptive Capex Actuals, Adaptive Opex Actuals
Notes: Prevents duplicate budget lines.

Step: Each resource has exactly ONE resource group on their employee profile (TEST, PROD)
Notes: Resource assignments take the group from it; done before the resource load.

Step: Portfolio 'Construction' exists; rate models, cost types (incl. Other Opex / Other Capex), fiscal years, Groups choice 'Business Partners'
Notes: Reference data - not in the update sets.

Step: Data Migration - once
1. Adaptive Programs - API -> Import Adaptive Programs
Data Migration - repeat per batch (x_mig.adaptive.batch = 1/7 ... 7/7; ~55 projects each)
Notes: Change the batch property only when every step of the current batch is Complete.

Step: 2. Adaptive Projects - API -> Import Adaptive Projects AND Import Adaptive Demands
Notes: Log line: 'Batch n of 7'.

Step: 3. Adaptive Project Tasks - API -> Import Adaptive Project Tasks
Estimate (all 381 projects): ~3 h 45 min per batch (~30 h; batch 7 ~8 h)
Notes: Critical path. Start right after 18.1.

Step: 4. Adaptive Status History - API -> Import Adaptive Status History (alongside 18.2)
Notes: Runs in parallel with Tasks.

Step: 5. Adaptive Budget Lines - API -> Import Adaptive Budget Lines (Order 100), then Import Adaptive Actuals (Order 200) (alongside 18.2)
Notes: Runs in parallel with Tasks.

Step: 6. Adaptive Resources - API -> Import Adaptive Resources (after 18.2 is Complete)
Notes: Longer once schedules are fixed (more inserts).

Step: 7. Adaptive Time Entries - API -> Import Adaptive Time Cards (after 18.2 is Complete, alongside 18.5)
Notes: Cards load as Pending.

Step: Validate the batch: background scripts batch_validation.js and import_errors_summary.js
Notes: Only expected skips: no ServiceNow user; Not Assigned; schedule-blocked resources.

Step: Data Migration - once after batch 7/7
Set x_mig.adaptive.batch = blank, x_mig.adaptive.scope = all
8. Adaptive Risks / Issues / Lessons Learned - API -> each own map
Notes: Not batched.

Step: 9. Adaptive Projects - API -> Projects + Demands maps (catch-up)
Notes: Picks up projects added in Adaptive during the batches; updates only.

Step: 10. Asana Projects - API -> Asana Projects map
Notes: Can run any time after step 1.

Step: 11. Asana Project Tasks - API -> Asana Project Tasks map
12. Time cards to Approved / Processed
Notes: Business rules on = ~6 s per card (~70,000 cards = days). Method to be decided: pre-load before the window, or load as Processed with one roll-up.

Step: 12b. Resource assignment groups: background script resource_assignment_group_fill.js (DRY_RUN first; fills only empty groups from the employee profile)
Notes: Safety net after the resource load; counts show any person still without a group.

Step: 13. Resource assignments to Allocated (background script)
Notes: After 16.1.

Step: 14. Attachments (run as background script in chunks - fix scripts not available in PROD)
x_mig.migration_running = false; notifications and rules back on
TOTAL (steps 17-19.5)
Notes: Tasks are ~80% of the time. Excludes 19.6-19.8 (being timed).
